page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg9i.12xlarge is a high-clock-speed compute instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor utilizing the x86_64 instruction set architecture. It incorporates 48 dedicated vCPUs backed by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at 3.4 GHz. System memory totals 192 GB, yielding an even distribution of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware accelerators are not present, providing zero GPUs.

The instance does not include bundled local storage, necessitating reliance on remote cloud block storage for operating system drives and persistent storage needs. Network connectivity is configured with a 25 Gbps baseline bandwidth allocation, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are provided with the profile. From a resource perspective, the high clock speed combined with dedicated vCPUs provides consistent processing execution, though workloads requiring ultra-low storage latency will depend entirely on external volume configurations.

With its 3.4 GHz baseline clock speed and standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, the ecs.hfg9i.12xlarge is well structured for processing-heavy workloads. Suitable deployment targets include relational database systems, application backends, batch data transformation pipelines, and high-concurrency web serving infrastructure.
